notes: «أبي، المنهال» is one man, kunya plus name across a comma (rule 7); the comma is kept as the text writes it
«فأتيت البراء بن عازب فسألته فقال» — the one asked answers, so Bara' is a link (rule 6); the sale of silver is the scene
«فأتيته فسألته فقال مثل ذلك» names Zayd b. Arqam for the same saying: a variant group, not a route
